title: docs(spec, plugin-security): the runtime package install, the enable of a disabled package and a hot upgrade carry renamedFrom holders at once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XXWfT73m4BSPgeTFD7644gK)_

Refs #33301

Follow-up PR for the card (PR 1 #33478 merged; PR 2 #33568 is the separate Tier H ADR leg). This one corrects the `PositionSchema.renamedFrom` text that #33448 and #33304/#33473 made false on `main`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只改文字与一条日志文案,不改行为。`PositionSchema.renamedFrom` 的 jsdoc 与 `.describe()`(及其生成的参考文档行)、`plugin-security` 迁移模块注释:运行时 `POST /packages` 安装、`PATCH /packages/:id/enable` 启用一个已停用的包、以及热升级,现在都"立即迁移",不再列为"等下次重启"。同时更正两条未发布的变更说明(同一句错话),以及 `claimant-disabled` 警告里"启用后的第一次启动才迁移"的说法。
- **为什么改**:#33478 合入时写了"运行时安装/启用不发通告,要等重启",但 #33448 已让两扇门发 `metadata:reloaded`;另外 #33304 让热升级撤回旧版职位(#33473 已在模块注释里改过),spec 文字还说要重启。契约评审 6886866329 指出前者。
- **风险与回滚**:无 schema、取值或行为变化;唯一发布的运行时字节是一条警告文案。`check-empty-changeset` 因有意更正两条未发布说明而保持红(DELIBERATE CORRECTION,见下)。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` 的 `renamedFrom` jsdoc 与 describe。
- **两分钟验证**:`git grep -n "do not announce\|does not announce, and" packages/spec/src/identity content/docs/references/identity`,预期无命中;对照 `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 里两处 `announcePackageReload` 调用。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位做契约复审并落地。

## What changes

Text only; no schema, accepted value or behaviour changes.

- `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts`, `renamedFrom` jsdoc: the doors carried at once are now a hot install-local install **or upgrade**, for the package the door announces, the runtime `POST /packages` install, a `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` that switches a disabled package on, a per-item publish and a publish-drafts. A package still disabled when its announcement is heard is refused `claimant-disabled` until the enable that switches it on announces it again. The other packages of a multi-package artifact (install-local announces only the artifact's own id, review 6889382518 on #33653; the code change is tracked in #33656) and an artifact reload that names only its file stay "at the next restart".
- Same file, `.describe()`: "(an install or hot upgrade of the package the door announces, the enable of a disabled package, a per-item publish, a publish of drafts). A package still disabled then is carried when it is enabled. The other packages of a multi-package artifact, and an artifact reload that names only its file, are carried at the next restart."
- `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` module doc: "When it runs" says a hot install-local install or upgrade is carried at once for the package the door announces, the other packages of a multi-package artifact at the next restart; the `claimant-disabled` bullet (~:48-51) now names the enable that carries, matching the warning reason.
- `content/docs/references/identity/position.mdx`: the `renamedFrom` row, regenerated (`pnpm gen:schema && pnpm gen:docs`), not hand-edited.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`, module doc "When it runs": the runtime install and the enable of a disabled package announce `app/ID` and are carried at once; an install that leaves the package disabled is refused `claimant-disabled` until that enable.
- `.changeset/33301-renamed-from-install-enable-announce.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.
- `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` ~:690, the `claimant-disabled` warning reason, FROM "the renamed position's package is disabled; the first boot after it is enabled carries them" TO "the renamed position's package is disabled; enabling it through `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` carries them, and so does the first boot after it is enabled". No test pins the string (`git grep` over `*.test.ts`); the only test of the refusal asserts `reason: 'claimant-disabled'`. This string ships in `dist`, so `.changeset/33301-claimant-disabled-log-reason.md` is an `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch.
- Two pending release notes, corrected in place (see DELIBERATE CORRECTION below).

### DELIBERATE CORRECTION of two pending release notes

`check-empty-changeset` stays red on purpose: both notes are unreleased and describe the same doors, and restoring them would publish sentences that are false on `main`.

- `.changeset/33301-renamed-from-carry-text.md` (this card's PR 1), FROM "(a hot install, a per-item publish of the position, a publish of drafts). A hot upgrade over a version the kernel still serves, a package install or enable that does not announce, and an artifact reload that names only its file are carried at the next restart." TO "(an install or hot upgrade, the enable of a disabled package, a per-item publish of the position, a publish of drafts). A package still disabled when it is announced is carried when it is enabled; an artifact reload that names only its file is carried at the next restart."
- `.changeset/33238-position-rename-hot-install.md` (#33238): the bullet "the runtime's package install and enable routes, which do not announce `metadata:reloaded`;" is removed from "Still carried at the next restart". "Carried at once" gains: "the runtime's package install (`POST /packages`) and the enable of a disabled package (`PATCH /packages/:id/enable`), which announce `app/ID` (`@objectstack/runtime`, #33302). A package still disabled when it is announced is not carried until the enable switches it on and announces it again."

### Where each claim is read on `main` (1cf2a5a9)

- Install announces on both answers: `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` ~:2781 `announcePackageReload(deps, _context, pkgId, 'installed')`, before the `enableOnInstall` lifecycle refusal returns.
- Enable announces only when the package was disabled: ~:2856 `if (wasDisabled) await announcePackageReload(…, 'enabled')`. Pinned by `packages-reload-announce.test.ts`.
- A disabled claimant is refused: `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` `claimant-disabled` (judged on the reload path as on boot), so an install that lands disabled carries nothing until the enable announces.
- Hot upgrade: `SchemaRegistry.replacingPackageBody` (#33050, landed in #33304) withdraws the positions the new body no longer ships inside `registerApp`; #33473 pinned it end to end through install-local and already corrected the carry's module doc, but not the spec text.

### Deviation from the prepared patch

The order's patch (be318a6d) no longer applied: #33473 had rewritten the carry's module doc under it. It was re-applied by hand, and it kept "a hot upgrade over a version the kernel still serves … carried at the next restart", which #33473 measured false. Re-asserting that in rewritten text would claim more than the code does, so the same sentences drop it. Round 2, at the seat's request, adds the warning string and the two pending notes below.

## Tests

None: a description and comment diff, no behaviour change.

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/plugin-security` changeset: the module-doc edit ships nothing (tsup strips comments; after the build `grep -rl 'enable of a' dist` has no hit), but the warning string does (`enabling it through` is in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`), so the package gets a patch note for the string.
- Left as is, at the seat's word: #33568's ADR-0150 wording still lists "a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves" as carried at the next restart, false since #33304. That is the card's ADR follow-up after #33568 merges.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Verification

At head `27a39b87` (`origin/main` `4c32b969` merged in), after building the lint, plugin-security, objectql, client-react and cli closures:

- 106 derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 104 exit 0; `--ran` reads "106 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 105 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
  - `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exit 1: the DELIBERATE CORRECTION above, red on purpose.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, a PREREQUISITE refusal: it reads every package's `dist`). CI runs it.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: 267 files, 6679 passed, 45 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0.
- Round 1 at `63085567`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` 840 files, 26871 passed, 1 todo; `gen:schema && gen:docs` moved only `content/docs/references/identity/position.mdx`. Round 2 does not touch `packages/spec`.

Round 3 at head `85543852` (`origin/main` `3c0033f9` merged in; the net diff against main was unchanged by the merges): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` 840 files passed, 1 skipped, 26878 passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` 267 files, 6679 passed, 45 skipped, `typecheck` exit 0 (at `a797bffe`; the round-3 edit after it is comment and describe text only, and `position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` 35/35 at `85543852`); `gen:schema && gen:docs` moved only the `position.mdx` row; `check:generated` (after a spec rebuild), `check:docs`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` and `check-issue-citations` exit 0.

Records: `pm-orders/spec/33301-followup-gates-ran.txt` (round 1) and `pm-orders/spec/33301-followup-r2-gates-ran.txt` (round 2) in the project share.
